title: Between Spoilers and Guesswork: Avoiding Over-Specification in Coding Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22760v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Benchmarks drive AI progress, but are hampered by task under-specification and over-specification. Task under-specification causes guesswork, where solutions have to make things up, or worse, resort to contamination or reward hacking. Task over-specification causes spoilers, where solutions can bypass some of the harder steps the benchmark was supposed to measure. Since future-looking benchmarks should be difficult, over-specification reduces a benchmark's shelflife of community adoption. Repository-level coding benchmarks have helped the field progress but experience unnecessary churn due to both over- and under-specification. For instance, SWE-bench Pro, FEA-bench, Doc2Feat-bench, and Multi-SWE-bench all tackle under-specification by augmenting task statements with hints derived from ground truth. translated_title: 在剧透与臆测之间：避免编程基准测试中的过度具体化
translated_abstract: 基准测试推动着人工智能的进步，但却受到任务具体化不足和过度具体化的困扰。任务具体化不足会导致臆测，即解决方案不得不凭空编造，或者更糟糕的是，诉诸数据污染或奖励作弊。任务过度具体化则会导致剧透，即解决方案可以绕过基准本应衡量的一些较难步骤。由于面向未来的基准测试应当具有挑战性，过度具体化会缩短基准在社区中被采用的保质期。仓库级编程基准测试帮助该领域取得了进步，但由于过度具体化和具体化不足的双重问题，它们经历了不必要的频繁更迭。例如，SWE-bench Pro、FEA-bench、Doc2Feat-bench 和 Multi-SWE-bench 都通过使用从真实答案中提取的提示来扩充任务描述，以解决具体化不足的问题。我们表明，将真实答案信息泄露到任务描述中会导致其中一些基准出现过度具体化的问题。我们进行了实验……
tldr: 该论文揭示了编程基准测试中通过向任务描述泄露真实答案信息来解决任务描述不足的做法反而会导致过度具体化（剧透）问题，使解决方案绕过基准本应考察的难点，并主张在剧透与臆测之间取得平衡以延长基准的使用寿命。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that coding benchmarks addressing under-specification by leaking ground-truth hints into task statements suffer from over-specification (spoilers), which lets solutions bypass the hard steps the benchmark aims to measure, and argues for balancing between spoilers and guesswork to extend a benchmark's shelf-life.
